# Game Idea: Asteroid Collector

- Control a ship on an HTML canvas with arrow keys.
- Collect floating gold nuggets for points.
- Avoid moving asteroids; any collision ends the game (lose condition).
- Fuel drains over time; running out of fuel also triggers loss.
- Display current score and high score.
